independence: Two separate subagents (Reviewer A, Reviewer B) were dispatched in parallel with explicit instructions to read ONLY the three raw extracted-text source documents and never access any Headroom/production output. Both were dispatched and completed their work before this session read the RIOT pipeline's compiled/verified output for comparison purposes (the pipeline run and the ground-truth authoring ran concurrently in the background, but neither reviewer's prompt referenced or granted access to the pipeline's output directory).
unit: Claim-level, source-grounded (gtClaimId, document, sourceSpan, covenantFamily, propositionType, materiality, shortDescription, requiredQualifiersConditions, quantitativeComponents, dependencies, amendmentOperativeStateRelevance, sourceEvidence).
sourceEvidenceVerification: Reviewer B's own process included programmatic verification that every sourceEvidence quote is a genuine (whitespace/quote-style-normalized) substring of the extracted text; Reviewer A's report did not describe an equivalent automated check but its excerpts were spot-checked as part of this synthesis and found consistent with the source documents.
note: Reviewers were explicitly told not to restrict themselves to negative covenants only and to cover the full breadth of material claim families present in the text.
